name: You are given the following quantum programming task. Generate a rotated surface
task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Generate a rotated surface code memory experiment in Stim (distance 3, 5 rounds, noise 0.008), decode with PyMatching, and compare logical error rates for distances 3 and 5 to show error suppression. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
